pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-sized, irregularly polygonal patches with moderately soft-to-sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Patch shapes transition from larger, more structured blocks on the neck to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the posterior flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pelage pathways with high pixel thickness relative to the patches. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial, forming a consistent topological web across the lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, erect mane along the cervical-dorsal transition. The silhouette shows a low-amplitude, high-frequency serration against the background, consistent with a uniform hair length profile.
